title: Refuse a rollout whose session_meta id differs from its file name
body: Outcome: scripts/rollout-usage.ts refuses (65) a rollout whose session_meta.id differs from the UUID in its file name, and a --thread or --run lookup requires both to equal the requested id or prefix. Evidence: PR #180 review attempt 3 (.krn/runs/review-series/9042aa359fd4dce4b8f4053731febaa4b0a023c2ea1d28f3d2694bfbebbc3d42/records/3.json) BLOCKING at scripts/rollout-usage.ts:617; overridden by the lead because only a corrupted or crafted sessions tree triggers it. Proof: a new observer with a mismatched session_meta.id, red at base by assertion.
